comments.body: axe DevTools flags 6 nodes on the overview page when prefers-color-scheme is dark.

content.text: axe DevTools flags 6 nodes on the overview page when prefers-color-scheme is dark.

In dark theme, secondary dashboard metrics (cycle time subtitle, percentile footnotes, compared-to-last-period deltas) use #8B8B9A on #1A1A24. Measured contrast is about 3.1:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text.
Those labels must meet AA in both themes. Primary numbers are fine; only the secondary line fails. Light mode already passes at 5.2:1.

Token color.text.muted was tuned for light backgrounds and reused as-is for dark. Splitting a color.text.muted.dark near #B0B0C0 or lifting the dark muted step one level should clear the audit without washing out the hierarchy.
